holdout_policy: Permanent benchmark and extrapolation key files are reused by default; every training run excludes matching rows unless --force-recreate-benchmark is explicitly used.

boundary_extensions.name: Z_79_low_rod_boundary
boundary_extensions.description: For Au low-rod extrapolation only, keep the curve's own boundary intercept and use a smoothed rod-direction slope estimated from training curves. Permanent benchmark and extrapolation rows are excluded before fitting this extension.

extrapolation_strategy.name: unified_local_regression_with_au_low_rod_boundary_extension
extrapolation_strategy.description: Use one unified artifact. Be/Al keep the baseline local cubic settings; Z=79 keeps adaptive local quadratic settings and adds a low-rod linear boundary extension whose slope is smoothed across Au training curves.
extrapolation_strategy.selected_by: permanent benchmark search requiring random benchmark and Be/Al metrics to stay unchanged while reducing Au contiguous low-rod extrapolation error
